Allelic distance between clones under the all-cell orientation

Source: R/clones_assign.R
clone_allelic_distance.Rd

Clone pseudobulk haplotype fractions per arm with every phase block oriented by the all-cell pseudobulk (oc: per cell x arm counts from orient_blocks without groups, computed once): D[k, l] = sum over arms of len x max(|f_k - f_l| - floor, 0) (bp x fraction). Events carried by a large share of the cells (trunk events, e.g. an arm loss in one tumour region, a chromosome lost on opposite haplotypes in two lineages, a gain in all tumour cells) are oriented correctly in nearly every block and give large differences; a subclone's private event is outweighed in the all-cell pseudobulk and contributes little. This is what makes the distance a trunk distance, unlike the clone state distance, where sibling clones with one misfitted segment are as far apart as different lineages.

Usage

clone_allelic_distance(oc, members, arms, floor = 0.03, min_mol = 200)

Arguments

oc

data.table cell (name), region (arm), nA, nB: all-cell oriented votes

members

data.table cell, clone

arms

regions table of the arms (region, start, end)

floor

noise floor of |f_k - f_l|

min_mol

arms with fewer pooled molecules in a clone are ignored for that clone's pairs

Value

symmetric numeric matrix clones x clones
